_comment: Edit this file (or copy to services.json — gitignored) to define your service categories, routing maps, and incident messaging templates. The script loads services.json if present, otherwise falls back to this file.

claude.prompt_template: Status page for the platform. Service affected: {service_name}. {base_ctx}{extra} Write ONE single message of exactly 2 very short sentences to inform customers. Brief, direct, professional, in {language}. No emojis, no quotes. Reply ONLY with the message, nothing else.

fallback_messages.downtime: We are currently experiencing an outage in {s}. Our team is working to resolve the issue.
fallback_messages.degraded: We are detecting degraded performance in {s}. Our team is investigating.
fallback_messages.intermittent: {s} is experiencing intermittent outages. We are investigating the cause.
fallback_messages.latency: We are detecting elevated response times in {s}. Our team is investigating.
fallback_messages.partial_errors: Some users are experiencing errors in {s}. We are working on a resolution.
fallback_messages.capacity: {s} is operating at reduced capacity. We are working to restore full capacity.
fallback_messages.investigating: We are investigating an issue in {s}. We will provide more information shortly.
fallback_messages.identified: We have identified the cause of the issue in {s} and are working on a solution.
fallback_messages.fixing: A fix is being applied to {s}. We expect it to be resolved shortly.
fallback_messages.monitoring: A fix has been applied to {s}. We are monitoring the results.
fallback_messages.resolved: The service has been restored and {s} is operating normally. Sorry for the inconvenience.
fallback_messages.maintenance: We will be performing maintenance on {s}. There may be brief interruptions.
fallback_messages.maint_update: Maintenance in {s} is still in progress. Thank you for your patience.
fallback_messages.maint_extended: Maintenance in {s} is taking longer than expected. Thank you for your patience.
fallback_messages.maint_end: Maintenance has finished. All services are operating normally.

claude_contexts.intermittent: State: intermittent outages, works at times.
claude_contexts.partial_errors: State: partial errors, some users affected.
claude_contexts.identified: State: cause identified, working on a solution.
claude_contexts.maint_extended: Type: maintenance extended beyond planned duration.

_comment_grafana_map: Maps Grafana alert label substrings (container/instance/job) to service keys. Edit per your fleet's naming convention.
_comment_betterstack_monitor_map: Ordered list of [substring, service_key]. First substring (case-insensitive) found in the BS monitor name decides routing. Edit to fit your monitor naming convention.
_comment_probe_guard: Names containing any of these substrings are dropped (case-insensitive) — protects the public status page from accidental triggers.
